caption: A flashlight is brought closer to a toy dinosaur standing in front of a wall, and the dinosaur's shadow on the wall grows larger.

sa.check: A toy dinosaur stands in front of a wall.
The flashlight is brought closer to the dinosaur.
The dinosaur's shadow on the wall grows larger.
The flashlight moves first and the shadow grows with it.

pc.expect: The shadow grows as the light approaches and shrinks as it backs away.
pc.fail: The shadow stays the same size while the light moves; or it shrinks as the light comes closer; or it changes size with the light still.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the dinosaur's outline as it grows.
pc.fail: It becomes a different shape; or splits; or the head and tail change places.

pc.expect: The shadow is on the wall behind the dinosaur, away from the flashlight.
pc.fail: It is between the dinosaur and the flashlight; or on the ceiling; or missing with the light plainly on.

pc.expect: The dinosaur stays where it stands.
pc.fail: It slides; or turns by itself; or lifts off.

pc.expect: One dinosaur, one flashlight and one shadow.
pc.fail: A second shadow appears under one light; or the dinosaur vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the flashlight passes through the dinosaur.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The dinosaur's colour and the wall stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The dinosaur changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the wall changes.
